scope: Unpublished shared fragment definition ADD/COPY/unplaced REMOVE in one ordinary registered recipe. No new release, commit, installation, device, author schema or execution backend protocol acceptance.
behavior: ADD appends a complete raw shared fragment. The independent GUI initially authors one catalog actor with position and explicit fields or projection inheritance, with groups:[].
COPY preserves the complete original fragment CST and changes only its fragmentId token; copied definitions remain unplaced and keep object/resource/local-key references.
REMOVE requires zero raw placement references and at least one remaining definition. It does not cascade into author documents, resources, placements or other definitions.
No generated instance or group UUIDs are allocated; exact eight-field proposals have targets:[] and existing effective actors and organizational relationships remain unchanged.
The complete candidate rebuilds every source contribution after declaration insertion/removal, including removal before placed fragments, and validates source identity and existing effective fields.
Unused declarations receive existing basic registered-object and explicit-image checks; effective projection defaults and actual image bytes are checked on first placement.

The final candidate uses portable synchronous Rust CST source locations, not a new server-exposed YAML dependency; this is a read-only operation under the same optional definitions ABI, not a fourth edit action.
All awaited review/apply work retains private source owner, raw approval and exact completion receipt. Memory application preserves the ordinary Save baseline and external-file conflict protection.

runtime.scope: Actual initial desktop preparation downloaded and verified the declared archive/license; fixed sidecar used for all final JS proofs. No installed application acceptance.

browser.networkDiagnosticsScope: Three background saved-preview requests encountered guarded world_read_conflict while author Save/rebuild changed the source; every explicitly reviewed candidate succeeded or failed as expected. Final Save conflict deliberately returned409. No private-module loading failure remained.
faultInjections: Nine candidate HTTP deliveries change position/order/actor provenance/group provenance/count/template pointer/source-range start/end/contributor order after the real server payload has been structuredClone-captured.
One actual response is held while its child is forcibly closed, parent closed and visible source input changes.
Only the new definitions capability export is absent or reports version2 in boot injections; all other WASM exports/DOM/controllers/HTTP remain real.
flowAssertions: ADD rejects duplicate local fragment IDs and incomplete numeric intent without losing authored input. Its valid one-actor/groups:[] declaration creates no placement or instance UUID; Cancel preserves every author file.

ADD remains definition-only across three 390px languages and silent unreviewed identifier changes cannot apply. Ordinary guarded Apply/Save/reopen preserves BOM/CRLF and original spans; the unused projection image remains unconsumed.

COPY duplicates the original CST span with only its fragmentId value replaced, retaining escaped property spelling, exponent coordinates, defaults flags, explicit null image and declaration order. Editing the copied shared group is independent; unplaced copy REMOVE has no cascade or generated identity effects.

The new definition flows through independent shared-actor creation, organization group creation/assignment and first placement. Only placement allocates stable UUID maps; its real HTTP candidate first resolves projection defaults and freezes the previously unused inherited image, then ordinary Save/reopen retains six actors.

Used definitions cannot be removed and the blocking placement is visible. Removing the middle unused declaration shifts later sourceLocations to their actual new fragment indexes; full actor/group provenance, effective geometry, source order and memberships remain exact.

ADD and COPY refuse a thirty-third fragment or a 129th declared actor before accepting a candidate, retain local identifier input and preserve each limit fixture. The last remaining definition cannot be removed.

An available ordinary OC with a raw inheritance flag remains a valid unplaced definition and can be copied without a ready-to-render promise. Its first placement fails the actual incompatible-projection HTTP check; no source is applied, and removing the unplaced copy remains allowed.

Nine modified deliveries—actor position/order/provenance, group provenance, fragment count, template pointer, source-range start/end and contributor order—cannot approve. The raw real server captures are detached before injection and remain valid; each rejected temporary previewId is released and the intent can be rechecked.
A real candidate arriving after child/parent close and a visible source edit cannot overwrite the new owner, reopen its dialog or grant approval; the preview is released.
When only the new definitions ABI is absent or unsupported, the ninth entry fails closed independently while all eight previous recipe editors still open/cancel through current real helpers.

Ordinary Save preserves the reviewed local copy and external disk bytes on conflict. Original OC/projections/images/metadata and all three limit fixtures remain byte-identical; definition authoring does not launch any execution backend.

prepared.scope: Actual desktop/mobile copied ESM/WASM in standard VM without Node/DOM/network globals or host imports; portability only, not installation/device acceptance.

retainedAttempts.reason: The new direct source-host fixture incorrectly expected a valid foreign registered scene UUID to be inferable from raw recipe source. Per existing contract, workflow/candidate own registered scene identity; direct prepare owns sourcePath/base/content and exact patches. Only the new fixture was corrected to invalid non-UUID sceneId; all remaining forged intents/targets/bytes/paths/revisions remain asserted. Product unchanged by this correction.

retainedAttempts.result: The existing doc-api browser-module-graph test caught the real new server-only YAML dependency: 2884 tests completed, 2883 passed and one failed. The final candidate removes that dependency; this initial product failure remains retained.
Actual successful workflow proof retained; no workflow failure is attributed to this attempt.

The NEW prepared domain fixture reused old provenance without decl.templatePointer. The final candidate guard correctly rejected it. Only the NEW prepared payload was corrected from the actual expanded templatePath; old fixtures and product behavior were unchanged.
Three actual workflows completed, then the NEW smoke compared raw object-map key insertion order rather than semantic mapping; only the new fixture changed.

Actual app boot failed after the new candidate imported server-only json-source; the later browser-third diagnostics confirmed the denied node_modules/yaml dependency. The second report itself is not presented as capturing that 404.
Actual 404 diagnostics for the same server-only YAML dependency retained; fixed by the final portable Rust source-location operation without widening the static allowlist.

limits: Existing 128 KiB, 32 definitions, 128 aggregate declared/expanded actors and groups; unused declarations count toward declaration budgets.
No fragment renaming/reordering, cascading delete, placement mutation, spatial transformation, nested/cross-file reuse, multi-file transaction or cross-view history.
No recipe execution backend, installed desktop build, Android authoring/device acceptance or unplaced-rendering guarantee.
